responsibility: Declares the rustc_const_eval MIR transform submodules, exposing const-checking and MIR validation as the transform-layer functionality of this crate.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `transform/check_consts/mod.rs`, which defines the shared context and helpers for const legality checking, this `mod.rs` is only the top-level transform namespace that exposes the crate's MIR transform areas (`check_consts` and `validate`). Unlike `const_eval/mod.rs` and `interpret/mod.rs`, it neither runs const evaluation nor assembles interpreter APIs; its scope is just organizing transform-layer modules.
